claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic clean-machine one-handoff acceptance matrix and caller-supplied evidence validator for Frankenstein 2.0. Bind every case to one exact release-manifest SHA-256 and pre-handoff receipt identity; require explicit Claude Code, Codex CLI, other-agent, no-VPS baseline and optional-VPS bridge cases; require real lifecycle-firing/state-readback/restart/update/uninstall observations where applicable; require single-state-lineage continuity; require perception permission-revocation evidence when perception is declared enabled; fail closed on missing, duplicate, mismatched or semantically insufficient evidence. The component only validates typed caller-supplied acceptance observations and emits READY_FOR_ADMISSION_REVIEW or BLOCKED candidate status with runtime_credit=0. No installer execution, filesystem/host mutation, live hook firing, VPS/SSH/container execution, provider/model/tool calls, UnifiedDB mutation, effects, physical-host credit, release acceptance or whole-system completion. Source/tests plus repository-hosted CI only.
authority_notes: synthetic/unit fixtures validate the acceptance logic but are not real clean-machine observations
READY_FOR_ADMISSION_REVIEW cannot mint runtime, physical-host, completion or whole-system credit
real host evidence must bind one exact final release manifest and pre-handoff receipt
